visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Exterior of a shop named 'REVERIE' in Seongsu-dong at dusk. A blonde woman in a white oversized shirt and brown boots dances outside, holding a long vertical strip of four photos. The shop has modern black frames and glowing white neon signs. (2) Interior of a photo studio. The woman stands in front of a mirror, trying on a large fluffy white bunny hat. A pink wire mesh wall behind her displays various colorful beanies and hats. (3) Inside a dark photo booth. The woman poses with a wired remote shutter against a black backdrop. The scene includes props like a retro television on a metal rack, several plush toys, and a studio spotlight providing high-contrast lighting. (4) A close-up screen capture of a computer monitor showing photo selection software. A hand is seen clicking a mouse to browse through various photos of the woman holding a teddy bear. The workspace is dimly lit with a keyboard and mouse visible. (5) Close-up shot of the woman holding the final printed giant photo strip in a clear plastic sleeve. The photos show her in different poses with the bunny hat and bear. The printed frame includes the text 'Reverie Black'. (6) Exterior street scene at night. The woman walks and spins down a narrow urban street with brick buildings and illuminated shop signs in Korean characters, proudly displaying her giant photos. (7) A screen capture of an iPhone camera interface showing the woman taking a selfie with the giant photos in a studio setting. The video concludes with a montage of the four individual photos she took, edited with a clean black-and-white theme.
